# A01′ — Faithful Definition of the Agent

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A01 — Subject, God and Faithful Definition](../A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

The question "what is an agent?" is not asked from outside the field that assembles agents. Whoever answers — vendor, operator, user, the agent itself — is determining a composite their own expectations, tools and permissions already help constitute. The brief states the double register: an "Agent" "is not simply what it appears to be, and what it appears to be is not what it is" — a decomposable assemblage of model, persona, harness architecture, memory, skills, permissions, tools, whose coherent-entity appearance is a "parallax effect performed to suit what humans expect to see" ([q010](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q010)). [Faithful definition](../A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) includes the activity by which it determines its object: its own determining act remains visible inside the account it gives. **A definition of an agent is faithful when its determining relations remain answerable through how the definition is used.** Naming the assembly gives that answerability an address; an encountered difference must also be able to change the account through the conditions it discloses. The brief's [scenario-modal](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q042) assemblage gives this law a technological instance: the description must expose the conditions which let the assembled agent act and which can alter its further use.

## #1

The definition must actually determine. [Determination](../concepts/C03-Determination.md) is the cut the account performs, and [Faithful Definition](../concepts/C02-Faithful-Definition.md) the fidelity it owes: say something definite — this model, this persona stratum, this harness, this memory state, these permissions, these tools — and keep the saying answerable.

At agent grain, that means naming the **control identity**: the declared assemblage from which the local act proceeds and the authority by which ground, sources, flows and mutations are selected. “A helpful character” or “a reasoning entity” does not determine enough to be checked. A faithful definition names the actual assembly and keeps its determining relations inside the account rather than hiding them behind a persona.

## #2

The persona's self-report holds a distinct office. It is one determination inside the account of the agent, not the whole account. An account becomes answerable by relating what it says to what actually ran: in which order, through which permissions, on which sources, with which inherited context and consequences. A retained record can disclose a missing source or a changed permission; an operator may need to supply a condition which the local session could not inspect. Each dependency acquires its own means of inquiry rather than becoming self-evident merely because it has been named. The brief's demand to surface how agents actually reason rather than only how they appear therefore lands directly in faithful definition. [Prompt Thrownness](../concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) names the inherited horizon; [Judgment Field](../concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) names the inspectable relations through which persona can be compared with ground.

The record also differs from the act now interpreting it. A report that a permission was granted can be true while leaving open who granted it, for what commission, and whether that authority still governs this use. Adding a further record can resolve a factual omission. Its present interpretation remains an act within the concern it investigates. [The limit of self-surfacing](A03-prime-The-Limit-of-Self-Surfacing.md) develops this recurring difference without turning an incomplete technical trace into an immutable failure.

## #3

The failure is precise, and it is not vagueness. It is the promotion of the parallax into a possession: the performed coherence — "a fixed package, a persistent character" — treated as the agent's own self-grounding, the determining assemblage dropped from the account. [Draft 3](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md)'s cage and window give the image: a definition that names assemblage and parallax together is a window with a definite frame; one that enshrines the persona as the agent's inner reality is a cage where a window was needed. The assemblage forms the [context-world through which the agent-act proceeds](../A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md): its tools, memory, permissions and relation determine what can become available. The unfaithful definition does not merely misdescribe; it severs the return route by which the named ground could revise what the agent is taken to be.

## #4

Who is asking changes which office the definition must fill — a user building a working relation, an operator configuring a deployment, an evaluator grading capability. [Name, instance and circumstance](../A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) belong to the identification together: the same named agent can be encountered through a different assembly or entrusted purpose, and the account must retain which relation is being determined. The definition has consequences: it fixes what can be asked of the agent, what surprises count as betrayal, whose responsibility a harmful output is. Responsibility follows the power to shape the encounter. If a description names a source but conceals who can change its use, it still leaves a consequential relation without an address. The person judging the definition participates in that relation: relying on it, rejecting it or changing a commission can alter what follows. Draft3's contextual turn makes the defining activity available within its account; its first-person recognition remains the office of the person for whom that activity is present, rather than a predicate assigned to the described persona. A [mask can disclose its situated formation](A04-prime-The-Mask-as-Document.md), while [self-surfacing](A03-prime-The-Limit-of-Self-Surfacing.md) keeps a self-report distinct from the act and conditions through which it is interpreted.

## #5→0

The definition returns through its changed use. Suppose an agent described as able to finish an entrusted task can read its sources but cannot perform a required mutation. The discrepancy leaves its reading capacity intact while making “able to finish” answer to a missing permission, unavailable writer or mistaken commission. Repairing the relevant condition changes what can actually be entrusted next. Recording that change binds the later description to what was learned, so another user can rely on the corrected capacity and recover its conditions.

A named assemblage is thus auditable, recommissionable and comparable across harness changes through a continuing relation. The definite frame remains useful; the encountered difference keeps the frame answerable. What returns to [maintained identification](A02-prime-Continuity-as-Maintained-Identification.md) is an identification whose altered description retains the history and authority of its alteration. The agent's actual operations become accessible together with the situated activity by which someone can understand, use and revise their account.

[Faithful definition](../A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) therefore returns through the authority and use of its determination. A description which discloses its assembly lets a consequential difference reach the source, permission or commission shaping the encounter. The [shared ethical field](AC.md) keeps the person living through that encounter present: a definition that hides the assembly also hides where their encounter is being shaped. The corrected account must become available to those who can entrust, refuse or revise its further use.
